title: Context card
description: One piece of work joined across agent sessions, git, pull requests, tickets and messages. A local card and a shared card have the same core: the problem, the goal, the state and what is next. They differ in their resources, the supporting context. A local card points to everything, local paths included. A shared card keeps what its reader can open (git, mcp, public, restricted resources, by link) and summarizes what they can't (local resources, without a path). The core is written by a model from the sessions and dated; everything else is data.

kind.description: session: an agent session transcript; memory: an agent memory file; change: uncommitted or unpushed changes; file: a file outside any git remote, or one that differs from it; folder: a checkout or worktree; branch: a branch on the remote; code: a file at a pushed commit; pr: a pull request; ticket: a ticket; message: a message or thread; page: a page or document in a service; artifact: a Claude artifact; link: a public web page

reach.description: local: only on the machine that made the card; git: on the repo's remote; mcp: in a service that agents reach through an MCP server; restricted: online but likely private to its owner; public: anyone can open it

ref.description: How to open it: path (local only), url, git and branch and commit, repo and path, source (the service), key, state

summary.description: What it tells someone who continues the work, written from the whole document when the card was shared. A shared card has it for every local resource, which has no ref there.

id.description: Stable id of the work: t:ABC-12 (ticket), b:<repo>@<branch> (branch; org/repo in a shared card) or s:<agent>:<session>

value.description: latent: defined, no material work; conscious: worked on now; subconscious: not done and quiet; etched: done; forgotten: unfinished and left

by.description: the git user name of the person whose work it is

ask.description: Shared cards: what the sender needs from the reader, in the sender's words

core.description: Written by a model from the sessions, as of 'as_of', with no local paths. A sentence that the live state contradicts ends with [outdated: what is true now].

goal.description: What done looks like, and why it matters

state.description: Where it stands, and what was decided

question.description: The open question that waits on the owner, in the last session's words when it can be

since_last_session.description: What git and GitHub show after the last session: merges, pushes

handoff.description: How someone on another machine picks the work up

start.description: commands that get the work, e.g. gh pr checkout 12

refresh.description: commands and links that get the live state again

last_words.description: Local cards: the end of the last session's last message

thread.description: Set when the card is published to a shared space: the thread it updates

local.description: Local cards only: what works only on the machine that made the card

resume.description: the shell command that resumes the last session
